snippet.title: EverRail Cinematic Trailer - FGS Live From GDC 2026
snippet.description:
A Cinematic Trailer for EverRail. EverRail is a 4 Player Co-Op open world survival title set in a frozen procedural world. Loot, Explore and upgrade your own train! EverRail is set to release for PC in Q2 of 2026

wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4134600/EverRail/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
